name: studio-kit
description: Build a full, multi-page, animated website in #html Volt - sticky nav, full-bleed hero banners, instant page switching, and scroll-triggered reveal animations. For studio/show/portfolio-style sites.

snippets.label: Studio kit (pages, nav, hero, scroll reveals)
snippets.description: Drop-in CSS + JS router + Volt functions for a multi-page animated site: navBar/navLink, pageOpen/pageClose, heroBanner, section, revealDiv, siteFooter.

snippets.label: Flipbook Studio (draw / play / export animation)
snippets.description: A standalone app, not a library to paste into another page - compile this file as-is. Draw frames on a paper-white canvas with onion skinning, play them back at an adjustable FPS, and export a single self-contained .html file that plays the animation with no Volt Studio needed.
